description: Předmět plnění veřejné zakázky: a) Spolupráce při zpracování Dokumentace EIA, zahrnující spolupráci a přípravu podkladů pro zpracovatele Dokumentace EIA uvedeného v čl. 4.15 ZTP, koordinaci technického návrhu s výstupy a doporučeními Dokumentace EIA a zapracování závěrů z procesu EIA do Projektové dokumentace pro povolení stavby dopravní infrastruktury (DPS). b) Zhotovení Projektové dokumentace pro povolení stavby dopravní infrastruktury (DPS) v režimu BIM, která specifikuje předmět Díla v takovém rozsahu, aby ji bylo možno projednat v řízení o povolení záměru, získat pravomocné povolení záměru (povolení stavby) dle zákona č. 283/2021 Sb., stavební zákon, ve znění pozdějších předpisů (dále jen „stavební zákon“), včetně Stanoviska oznámeného subjektu ve fázi vydání povolení záměru a činností koordinátora BOZP při práci na staveništi ve fázi přípravy včetně zpracování plánu BOZP na staveništi a manuálu údržby. c) Zpracování a podání žádosti o vydání povolení záměru dle stavebního zákona, včetně všech vyžadovaných podkladů, jejímž výsledkem bude vydání povolení záměru (povolení stavby). Dodavatel bude spolupracovat při vydání příslušných rozhodnutí do nabytí jejich právní moci. d) Zpracování Díla v režimu BIM a vytvoření Informačního modelu BIM dle Přílohy č. 11 Smlouvy o dílo s názvem BIM protokol, včetně všech jeho příloh. Informační model je součást Díla a bude zpracováván, projednávám a odevzdáván průběžně a společně s ostatními části Díla dle Harmonogramu plnění dle Přílohy č. 5 Smlouvy o dílo. e) Koordinační činnost dodavatele, jejíž náplní je koordinace této zakázky a zhotovitelů zakázek „Železniční uzel Brno, etapa Černovice“, „Železniční uzel Brno a etapa Židenice“. Cílem je zachování jednotné koncepce technického řešení a všech částí dokumentace. f) Zhotovení Aktualizace Záměru projektu (AZP) podle Pravidel přípravy a realizace akcí dopravní infrastruktury financovaných Státním fondem dopravní infrastruktury (dále jen „Pravidla MD“). Rozsah tohoto plnění si Objednatel vyhrazuje jako změnu závazku ze smlouvy v souladu s ustanovením § 100 odst. 1 ZZVZ. Plnění bude Zhotovitel realizovat na základě pokynu Objednatele při překročení předpokládaných investičních nákladů o 10 % anebo při zásadních změnách technického řešení stavby. g) Tvorba dat pro potřeby provozu GIS portálu (systém pro veřejnost), průběžná správa a aktualizace dat portálu na základě požadavků zadavatele, nebo připomínek veřejnosti. h) Výkon Dozoru projektanta při zhotovení PDPS. Bližší specifikace předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky je upravena v dalších částech zadávací dokumentace.

title: APN - EPC Procurement and Financial Advisory Services
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE Standing Offer for Energy Performance Contract Procurement and Financial Advisory Services (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform consultants of an upcoming Standing Offer opportunity. The purpose of this APN is to allow consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential Standing Offer, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances. Please note that there is no guarantee that this Standing Offer will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted below. This is conditional upon funding approval by DND. APN Number: EPFS2601 Approximate Estimate: 800,000$ Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Energy Performance Contract Procurement and Financial Advisory Services The Consultant will be required to provide “as and when required” procurement and financial advisory services in support of Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs). The services may include, but are not limited to, the following: Review and provide procurement and financial advice on the contractual documents including the Request for Proposal (RFP) financial evaluation criteria; Support DCC in preparing draft responses to financial questions from Proponents during the procurement phase; Review and provide advice on the financial evaluation framework to assess the Proponent’s financial capabilities; Assist DCC with the evaluation of the financial component of the Proponents proposals; Support DCC in the review and analysis of the financial proposal received following the feasibility study; Assist in the negotiation and finalizing the final terms of the contract. The objective is to select one (1) consultant capable of providing deliverables in both official languages (English and French). The estimated value of the Standing Offer is approximately $500,000 over an initial two (2)-year period, with the option to extend the Standing Offer for up to two (2) additional one (1)-year periods and to increase its value by an additional $300,000 at any time. The total estimated potential value of the Standing Offer is approximately $800,000 over four (4) years. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for the issuance of a Standing Offer, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing consultants early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, consultants that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal,   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Consultants that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Patricia Biernat Procurement Specialist Defence Construction Canada 819-500-8074 Patricia.Biernat@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. title: 2027 Construction Inspection Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: Federal Highway Administration Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division Construction Inspection and Management Support Services (MATOC) Solicitation No. 693C73-27-R-000006 The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division (EFLHD), anticipates awarding up to four Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts for construction inspection and other professional engineering services for the administration, oversight, and design of construction contracts performed by EFLHD on behalf of various Federal Land Management Agencies (FLMAs). These agencies include the National Park Service, the U.S. Forest Service, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, and the Bureau of Land Management within the continental United States and its territories. This acquisition will be solicited and awarded on a competitive basis and is being made under the North America Industry Classification Code 541330 via full and open competition with small business reserves, per FAR 19.112. Two of the four anticipated IDIQ contracts will be reserved for small business concerns, if qualified. The planned duration for each of the IDIQ contracts is a total of five years (one base year plus four option years). The shared capacity of the IDIQs will be $60,000,000. In support of onsite construction activities, the types of work the Architectural-Engineer (A-E) firms may be required to perform under this MATOC include but are not limited to: inspection and documentation of construction activities; monitoring contractor compliance with plans, specifications, and contract requirements; review of contractor submittals; coordination of materials inspection and testing; monitoring of safety and environmental compliance; preparation of daily reports and progress documentation; schedule monitoring; and other related construction inspection and engineering support services. Construction projects supported under these contracts may include roadway construction and rehabilitation; bridge repair or replacement; drainage improvements; erosion and sediment control measures; traffic control; signage installation; safety improvements; and other transportation-related infrastructure improvements. The REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS (RFQ) - PHASE I should be issued on or about November 20, 2026. The due date for receipt of Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) will be specified in the RFQ. IMPORTANT SAM REGISTRATION AND PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS: In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.204-7 (DEVIATION NOV 2025), prospective contractors shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer in response to a solicitation and at the time of award. To register in SAM, go to https://www.sam.gov. Annual contractor representations and certifications must be completed online at https://www.sam.gov. Also, FAR 52.232-33 requires SAM registration for payment. It is the Offerors' responsibility to check the Internet address provided as necessary for any posted changes to this pre-solicitation, the future RFQ solicitation, and/or amendments.

title: RFI - FEMA - Supply Chain Management System (SCMS)
description: FEMA�s Logistics Management Directorate, Logistics Systems Division, is conducting market research to identify commercially available cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions and associated services to transition, implement, operate, maintain, modernize, and support the FEMA Supply Chain Management System (SCMS). The anticipated requirement supports disaster logistics operations, including order and inventory management; warehouse and transportation operations; asset and in-transit visibility; point-of-distribution support; supply-chain reporting; procurement and enterprise resource planning interfaces; and financial reconciliation. FEMA is seeking solutions capable of supporting routine operations and scalable disaster-response surge requirements. The anticipated scope may include transition and implementation services, configuration and integration, recurring SaaS licensing, operations and maintenance, help desk and technical support, cybersecurity and system authorization support, continuity of operations, training, reporting, and optional surge capacity. FEMA anticipates a cloud-based solution or service model with approved system-to-system interfaces and applicable security, privacy, accessibility, and safeguarding requirements. This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market research and acquisition-planning purposes. It is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, or commitment by the Government. No contract will be awarded from this RFI. Interested parties should review the attached Draft Statement of Work, Vendor Streamlined Profile Matrix, and Targeted Market Research Questionnaire for complete information and response instructions.

Flight Test, Telemetry and Termination (FT3) Flight Test Kit Production
description: 1. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT This is a Solicitation Synopsis issued by the Department of the Air Force, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC/NIKM), Hill AFB, UT. This solicitation is for the production and delivery of flight test kit replenishment spares for the Flight Test, Telemetry, and Termination (FT3) Program. These kits directly support the Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Force Development Evaluation Operational Test Launch (OTL) Program. 2. SOLE-SOURCE JUSTIFICATION The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source: The Boeing Company (CAGE: 0B0D7), located in Layton, UT, under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1 (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements). Market research, including a Sources Sought Synopsis (FA8214-25S-FT3PD) and Pre-solicitation Notice (FA821426RB004-PRESOL), concluded that Boeing is the only source with the unique technical data, specialized engineering expertise, and established manufacturing infrastructure required to meet the Government's strict performance schedules. Award to any other source would result in an estimated minimum duplication of $80M in costs and an unacceptable delay of at least three (3) years. 3. PROGRAM SCOPE & REQUIREMENTS The resulting contract is anticipated to be a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) vehicle containing the following primary parameters: Quantity: Production and delivery of twenty-five (25) FT3 flight test kits. Delivery Schedule: Just-in-time delivery to Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, precisely 120 days prior to scheduled Operational Test Launches (OTLs). Period of Performance: October 2027 through September 2035. Total Estimated Program Value: Approximately $955M (including potential future procurements executed under an approved Class J&A). 4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS & INTEREST This notice is not a request for competitive proposals, and a written solicitation will be issued directly to The Boeing Company. However, any responsible source that believes it can meet these requirements may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Information received will be evaluated solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. All responses must be submitted electronically to the Points of Contact listed below no later than the Response Deadline indicated in this posting.

title: France – Beach cleaning services – ENTRETIEN DES PLAGES ET DU LITTORAL
description: ***Le présent marché a pour objet, l'entretien des plages et du littoral de la commune de Roquebrune-sur-Argens et leur maintien en parfait état de propreté. Toutes les prestations du présent marché pourront être commandées à tout moment. L'entreprise devra mettre en oeuvre tous les moyens nécessaires à la réalisation des prestations suivantes : - Nettoiement des plages et du littoral : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement manuel des plages (de sables ou de galets), des criques, des ouvrages piétonniers divers (chemin des douanier, sentier, accès, mises à l'eau et autres cheminements), des grèves rocheuses, des ouvrages de protection des plages (talus, épis, sorties pluviaux...), ainsi que l'ensemble des secteurs se rattachant au périmètre défini au CCTP entre les limites de communes de Fréjus et Sainte Maxime. - Collecte des poubelles de plages et du littoral : Cette opération consiste à collecter les poubelles mises en place sur les plages, le long de la RD559 et du littoral Sambracitain (côté mer). - Le criblage des plages de sable : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement mécanique des plages de sable et des criques de sable se rattachant au périmètre défini à l'article 1.3.1. du CCTP. Cette prestation inclut la collecte et l'évacuation en décharge de tous déchets, détritus ou autres matières. - Le reprofilage ponctuel des plages et de leur accès à effectuer avant la période estivale et après les coups de mer ou fortes pluies (sorties de ruisseaux et pluviaux). - Gestion de la posidonie : Cette opération est à effectuer avant la période estivale et selon les besoins. En accord avec les préconisations environnementales, la posidonie sera déplacée sur la même plage, et stockée, par couches alternées posidonie/sable. - Gestion du volume de sable : Cette opération est à prévoir en amont de la saison et en fin de saison, le principe étant de constituer une réserve de sable en fin de saison qui permettra lors de la saison suivante " d'engraisser " les plages concernées. - Concassage des plages : Cette opération sera planifiée en amont de chaque saison en fonction des nécessités, afin d'améliorer la granulométrie du sable.

Die GL übernimmt die integrale Führung und Koordination des Planerteams und stellt die Abstimmung mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten sicher. Die detaillierten geforderten Aufgaben und Leistungen der GL gemäss SIA 103 sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (vgl. Anhang 1) und in der Leistungstabelle (vgl. Anhang 2) genauer erläutert. Das Mandat der Verkehrsplanung und Landschaftsarchitektur ist im Mandat der GL (Teil der Ausschreibung Gesamtleitung) integriert. Sämtliche notwendigen Planer*innen sowie auch Landschaftsarchitekt*innen und Verkehrsplaner*innen sind der GL organisatorisch und fachlich unterstellt.

title: D46 MÚK Držovice
description: Předmětem zakázky je rekonstrukce mimoúrovňové křižovatky MÚK Držovice na silnici D46 (E462), která v současném stavu nevyhovuje platným technickým normám ani požadavkům na bezpečný a plynulý provoz. Stávající mostní objekt ev. č. 46–014B je ve zhoršeném technickém stavu a vyžaduje nahrazení novou konstrukcí. Současně je nevyhovující uspořádání křižovatky z hlediska kapacity a bezpečnosti provozu. Realizací stavby dojde k přestavbě křižovatky, doplnění připojovacích a odbočovacích pruhů a úpravě dopravního řešení včetně napojení na okolní komunikační síť. Součástí je také vybudování nové okružní křižovatky na ulici Konečná. Cílem zakázky je zvýšení bezpečnosti silničního provozu, zlepšení plynulosti dopravy a zajištění dlouhodobě vyhovujícího technického stavu dopravní infrastruktury na silnici D46.

title: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) Data Center, National Capital Region
description: Advance Procurement Notice   Data Center, (Modify design Built) National Capital Region (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity located within the National Capital Region (Ontario). The purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Description of the Project and Services It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed Project Number: WA257004 Contract Number: 88262 Title: Data Center NCR Approximate Estimate: 1.5B to 1.85B Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027 Description: To increase its capacity in supporting the mid to long-term objectives related to operations, security, and technology modernization, the Government of Canada is planning to design and construction a data center facility within the National Capital Region. This Data center of 60 MW will enable the onboarding of next-generation capabilities with tailored mechanical and electrical configurations to meet distinct technology requirements throughout the facility. The proposed data centre facility will also include a small office space and a shipping and receiving area. The estimated cost of the proposed Modified Design-Build (MDB) Contract exceeds $1.5 to 1.85B. It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in Winter 2027.  This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Government of Canada. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. As of the date of posting of this Advance Procurement Notice, the required security clearance(s) are anticipated to be: for design-builders: a valid Facility Security Clearance (FSC).  Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builders has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Design-Builder that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca   Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Stephanie Tanguay Regional service line leader, Contract services Defence Construction Canada 613-715-4626 stephanie.tanguay@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Gesamtleitung Mittelfristmassnahmen, Thunstrasse West/Ost
description:
Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe eines Mandats für die Gesamtleitung (GL) für die Mittelfristmassnahmen Thunstrasse West und Ost über die SIA-Phasen 32 bis 53. Die GL übernimmt im Auftrag von Tiefbau Stadt Bern die operative Führung und stellt die zielgerichtete Umsetzung der Projektziele von der Phase Bauprojekt bis zum Projektabschluss sicher.


Die GL übernimmt die integrale Führung und Koordination des Planerteams und stellt die Abstimmung mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten sicher. Sie koordiniert insbesondere die Bereiche Strassenbau, Werkleitungsplanung und -bau, Verkehr und Landschaftsarchitektur sowie die relevanten Schnittstellen zu Drittprojekten und angrenzenden Infrastrukturen. Dabei berücksichtigt sie die besonderen Anforderungen des innerstädtischen und hochfrequentierten Projektperimeters und unterstützt die Bauherrschaft bei der Vorbereitung und Begleitung von fachlichen, organisatorischen, rechtlichen und politischen Entscheiden.


Die detaillierten geforderten Aufgaben und Leistungen der GL gemäss SIA 103 sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (vgl. Anhang 1) und in der Leistungstabelle (vgl. Anhang 2) genauer erläutert.

Das Mandat der Verkehrsplanung und Landschaftsarchitektur ist im Mandat der GL (Teil der Ausschreibung Gesamtleitung) integriert. Sämtliche notwendigen Planer*innen sowie auch Landschaftsarchitekt*innen und Verkehrsplaner*innen sind der GL organisatorisch und fachlich unterstellt.

description: Voorwerp van deze diensten: Raamovereenkomst voor het wassen, reinigen en herstellen van interventiekledij en het huren en wassen van huishoudelijk linnen. Toelichting: Voorwerp van deze diensten: De onderhavige opdracht heeft betrekking op het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één (of twee) opdrachtnemer(s) voor het wassen, reinigen en herstellen van interventiekledij en het huren en wassen van huishoudelijk linnen. Deze raamovereenkomst beoogt het vastleggen van de voorwaarden waaronder, gedurende de looptijd van de overeenkomst, prestaties kunnen worden besteld met betrekking tot het periodiek reinigen en het uitvoeren van herstellingen aan de interventiekledij van de opdrachtgever en het huren en wassen van huishoudelijk linnen, o.a. lakens, kussenslopen, handdoeken, vaatdoeken,… . De raamovereenkomst houdt geen enkele afnameverplichting in vanwege de opdrachtgever. De opdrachtgever behoudt zich het recht voor om prestaties te bestellen naar eigen behoefte en goeddunken, zonder dat enige minimale of maximale afname gegarandeerd wordt. De raamovereenkomst wordt niet-exclusief toegekend. De opdrachtgever behoudt zich het recht voor om, al dan niet via andere procedures, soortgelijke diensten bij derden te betrekken zonder dat de opdrachtnemer hieruit enig recht op vergoeding of schadevergoeding kan putten. Plaats van dienstverlening: Hulpverleningszone Taxandria, Noord Brabantlaan 68, 2300 Turnhout, in concreto op volgende brandweerposten: - 2300 TURNHOUT - Parklaan 12 - 2320 HOOGSTRATEN - St Lenaartseweg 38 De opdracht loopt initieel voor 24 maanden en kan 2 keer stilzwijgend verlengd worden met één jaar, in totaal dus 48 maanden. title: France-Villeneuve-Loubet: Motor vehicles
Mountainbike-Trails am Horneggli, Gemeinde Saanen
description:
• Realisierung von mehreren Mountainbike-Trails, die grösstenteils neu gebaut werden sollen. Einige kurze Abschnitte führen über bestehende Wege/Flurstrassen in Koexistenz mit anderen Nutzungsformen, teilweise mit Wandern oder teilweise mit der Landwirtschaft. Auf diesen müssen bikespezifische Unterhaltsmassnahmen (v.a. nachhaltiges Entwässerungs-Management, Sicherung der Wegoberfläche) umgesetzt werden.
  • Die Strecken führen von den Bergstationen Hornberg (Los 1), resp. Horneggli (Los 2), hinunter nach Schönried (Talstation Horneggli)
  • Ziel ist die Schaffung von attraktiven und bedürfnisgerechten Trails, welche sicher & möglichst nachhaltig gebaut sind, welche die Bikenden lenken und mittels "State-of-the-Art" Trail-Design optimalen Fahrspass ermöglichen.
  • Infrasturuktur-Typen sind:

Los 1) Eine naturnah gebaute Mountainbike-Strecke (Flow-/Style-Trail) in einfacher Schwierigkeit (blau), ⌀-Trail-Breite: 1.25m

Los 2) Zwei naturnah gebaute Mountainbike Strecken (1 x Tech-Trail und 1x Tech-/Style-Trail), beide in mittlerer Schwierigkeit (rot), ⌀-Trail-Breite: 1.1m

  • Als Bauwerke sind vorgesehen: Der Trail selbst, versch. Kunstbauten zu Gewässerquerungen, Holzstege ohne Geländer, versch. Schikanen zur Geschwindigkeitsreduktion, Steinarmierungen zur nachhaltigen Sicherung der Wegoberfläche, optionale seitliche Trail-Features (Spiel-/Progressionselemente).
  • Zusätzlich fallen Ersatzmassnahmen an, welche aktuell noch in Abklärung & Planung sind. Diese werden ggf. zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt an den/die Anbieter vergeben. Hierfür werden nur die Regietarife von den Anbietern angefragt.
  • Alle weiteren Infos und techn. Angaben sind den beigelegten Unterlagen (Auszug technischer Bericht und den Planbeilagen) zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and surveying services – Objektplanung - BBS I, Umsetzung Brandschutzkonzept
description: Die Stadt Delmenhorst hat aufgrund von festgestellten Mängeln bei einer Brandschutzbegehung ein Brandschutzkonzept in Auftrag gegeben. Dieses soll nun bauordnungsrechtlich genehmigt werden und die darin beschriebenen Brandschutzmaßnahmen geplant und umgesetzt werden. Für die Planung der technischen Anlagen in den Gebäuden (Brandwarnanlage, Hausalarmierungsanlage, Sicherheitsstromversorgung, Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen und elektrische Leitungsanlagen) wird ein Fachplaner hinzugezogen. Für die erforderlichen Maßnahmen wurde im Rahmen des Brandschutzkonzeptes eine Priorisierungsliste erstellt. Die Hauptmaßnahmen hieraus sind die Errichtung von zwei notwendigen Außentreppen als bauliche 2. Flucht- und Rettungswege, die Ertüchtigung der Hausalarmierungsanlage des Hauptgebäudes auf eine Brandwarnanlage mit Sicherheitsstromversorgung, der Einbau einer Hausalarmierungsanlage im Nebengebäude, Einbau von Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen mit Sicherheitsstromversorgung, Ausführung elektrischer Leitungsanlagen mit Funktionserhalt, Herstellung einer Rauchableitung mit Auslösestellen in einem Treppenraum, Herstellen einer Rauchableitung für den Aufzugschacht im Dach und weitere diverse Brandschutzmaßnahmen, wie z.B. der Austausch von Türen und Verglasungen mit brandschutztechnischer Anforderung oder ein Verschließen ehemaliger Türöffnungen. In bestimmten Bereichen sind Bauteile auf ihre Brandschutzqualität zu überprüfen und ggf. zu ertüchtigen oder in geforderter Qualität zu errichten, dies betrifft insbesondere Leitungsdurchführungen und deren Schottung, Installationsschächte, Entlüftungseinrichtungen innenliegender Bäder und Anschlusspunkte im Bereich der Dächer.

TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: PFAS-Free Sulfonated Poly(norbornene) Ionomeric Binders
description: A Cleaner, Tunable Alternative for Hydrogen Fuel Cells and Water Electrolyzers Hydrogen energy systems depend on a small but critical polymer layer inside each electrode, called an ionomeric binder, that shuttles protons, manages water and lets reactant gases reach the catalyst. The industry has long relied on perfluorosulfonic acid (PFSA) materials for this role, which contain PFAS (per? and polyfluoroalkyl substances) � �forever chemicals� � now under increasing regulatory pressure. Researchers at Los Alamos National Laboratory have developed a family of highly sulfonated poly(norbornene) ionomers that are entirely PFAS-free, deliver strong proton conductivity, do not poison precious-metal catalysts the way conventional aromatic alternatives do, and can be chemically tuned to keep electrodes dry under load. Together, these qualities position the material as a drop-in path forward for high-performance proton exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cells and water electrolyzers in a tightening environmental landscape. How it Works PFAS-Free Sulfonated Poly(norbornene) Ionomeric Binders are a class of aliphatic sulfonated poly(norbornene) polymers designed specifically as electrode ionomers in proton-conducting devices. The polymer�s backbone is built from fused bicyclic norbornane units that lack the aromatic pi-electron systems found in conventional hydrocarbon ionomers. The absence of those electrons means the polymer does not strongly adsorb onto platinum catalyst surfaces, so catalytic activity is preserved. Sulfonic acid groups covalently attached onto this backbone supply the proton-conducting pathways, while the bulky bicyclic rings create extra free volume inside the polymer, allowing oxygen and hydrogen to diffuse more easily through the binder layer and reach the catalyst. By adjusting the ratio of sulfonated to non-sulfonated segments, the developers can dial in ionic activity and hydrophobicity to prevent electrode flooding, a persistent issue for PFAS-free ionomers when operated at high current density. Technology Description In a PEM fuel cell or water electrolyzer, the membrane electrode assembly (MEA) is the heart of the device, and the electrode ionomer inside it must simultaneously conduct protons, transport water, allow reactant gases to reach catalyst particles and bind mechanically to both the membrane and the catalyst layer. PFSA materials such as Nafion meet these requirements but carry the environmental burden associated with perfluorinated chemistries. Hydrocarbon-based sulfonated polymers offer a cleaner, lower-cost route, yet their phenyl-rich backbones tend to adsorb onto platinum and reduce catalytic activity, their gas permeability is typically low and the high sulfonic acid content needed for conductivity drives down hydrophobicity, leading to flooding under realistic operating conditions. PFAS-Free Sulfonated Poly(norbornene) Ionomeric Binders target each of these failure modes simultaneously by replacing the phenyl-heavy architecture with a sulfonated poly(norbornene) platform. Advantages Contains no PFAS, helping device makers stay ahead of tightening regulations on perfluorinated chemicals Maintains catalyst activity by avoiding the platinum-adsorbing phenyl groups common in other hydrocarbon ionomers Allows higher gas permeability for improved reactant transport at the electrode Offers tunable hydrophobicity to keep electrodes from flooding during demanding operation Built on a polymer platform with demonstrated thermal stability and mechanical durability Synthesized from lower-cost, structurally tunable starting materials compared with perfluorinated chemistries Market Applications Hydrogen Energy (PEM fuel cells, water electrolyzers, reversible fuel cells) Transportation (fuel cell vehicles, heavy-duty trucking, maritime auxiliary power) Stationary Power and Backup (data centers, telecom, distributed generation) Industrial Gas and Chemicals (hydrogen production for refining, ammonia, steel) Aerospace and Defense (unmanned systems, portable power packs) TRL 4 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-25232 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: True Silicone DLP Printing Platform
description: The True Silicone DLP Printing Platform from Los Alamos National Laboratory allows for more geometries in producing genuine silicone parts, gaskets, lattices, prosthetic components or microfluidic devices on an off-the-shelf desktop printer typically required by specialty extrusion equipment. The result is a material whose polymer backbone is built entirely of silicon-oxygen bonds rather than the carbon-based linkages that quietly compromise so-called silicones on the market today. The True Silicone DLP Printing Platform unlocks that capability through a precursor resin and a paired printing workflow that together deliver real silicone parts free of metal catalyst residues, with tunable porosity, geometric complexity and the aging stability that demanding applications require. How it Works The platform begins with a printable resin that blends a polymerizable scaffold with a curable siloxane component, along with a photoinitiator and a small amount of a light-absorbing dye to control polymerization depth. A standard DLP printer cures the acrylic scaffold layer by layer to lock the geometry in place, after which the part is heated so the siloxane oligomers crosslink into a continuous silicone network alongside the scaffold. A wash in ethanol, water or ammonium hydroxide then dissolves the sacrificial scaffold, leaving behind a pure silicone object whose polymer backbone consists solely of silicon�oxygen bonds and retains a porous structure where the sacrificial scaffold was removed. Technology Description At its core, the True Silicone DLP Printing Platform relies on a printable resin that combines two chemistries chosen to work in tandem: an acrylic component that polymerizes quickly under light to hold the printed geometry, and a silicone component that cures more slowly into the final material. During printing, these two phases remain mixed but separate into interwoven networks, an arrangement that lets the silicone retain the intended shape once the acrylic is later removed. A small amount of light-absorbing dye keeps polymerization confined to the intended pattern, and the resin is engineered to flow and cure reliably on standard DLP hardware. After printing, the part is gently heated to complete formation of the silicone network, then soaked in an alcohol or water-based wash, sometimes assisted by UV light or a mild base, to dissolve away the sacrificial acrylic scaffold. What remains is a silicone object whose polymer backbone is built entirely from silicon-oxygen bonds, with mechanical properties and a controllably porous structure whose open pores can be accessed after printing to imbue the silicone with new functionalities, for example by infusing conductive or otherwise active materials. The overall workflow is compatible with inexpensive commodity printers and lends itself to scaling through emerging light-based manufacturing techniques, while the same scaffold-and-wash strategy offers a template for printing other materials that have historically been difficult to fabricate by photopolymer methods. Advantages Produces true silicone with a continuous silicon-oxygen backbone, avoiding the aging and chemical-compatibility weaknesses of pseudo-silicone alternatives Runs on widely available, low-cost DLP printers rather than specialized direct-ink-write equipment Cures whole layers at once, delivering meaningfully higher throughput than extrusion-based silicone printing Yields parts free of residual metal catalysts, simplifying regulatory and biocompatibility pathways Allows tunable mechanical properties and porosity through resin ratios and porogenic solvent choice Extensible in principle to other material systems that currently resist photopolymer printing through the same sacrificial-scaffold approach Market Applications Medical and Consumer Health (prosthetics, wearable devices, soft implants) Sensing (stretchable circuits, soft robotics components) Microfluidics (lab-on-chip components, custom flow cells) Aerospace and Defense (cushioning foams, vibration-isolation components, sealing parts) Optics and Photonics (soft lenses, light-guiding elements) Consumer and Household Goods (kitchenware, mattresses, apparel components) Development Status: TRL 4 U.S. Patent No. 11,939,415 LA-UR-26-24892 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. description: On September 29, 2026, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Technology Acquisitions Center (TAC) in support of the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), National Radiation Oncology Program, awarded a Firm Fixed Price contract to Radformation, Inc., 261 Madison Avenue New York, NY 10016, for an Enterprise-wide Radiotherapy Technical Quality Assurance (QA) System and Repository. The contract will provide a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) online, vendor-agnostic, enterprise-wide Software as a Service (SaaS) Radiotherapy Quality Assurance (QA) solution that standardizes, automates, and centralizes treatment delivery device QA data acquisition, analysis, and reporting across all VA Radiation Oncology Centers. The solution will streamline quality monitoring of linear accelerators (linacs) and other radiation treatment devices, including, but not limited to, brachytherapy and other non-linac teletherapy systems; imaging systems, including diagnostic systems such as computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) devices, as well as on-board imaging and other radiotherapy positioning verification and monitoring systems; and QA devices across diverse vendors. The solution shall comply with the applicable requirements of the American Association of Physicists in Medicine (AAPM) Task Group (TG)-142, TG-51, TG-198, as well as Medical Physics Practice Guidelines (MPPG) and Protocols. The period of performance shall consist of a 12-month base period, with four 12-month option periods.

title: Klärwerk Koblenz_Rahmenvertrag Flockierungsmittel
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Dienstleistung von Flockungsmittel für das Klärwerk Koblenz. Die Kläranlage Koblenz behandelt hauptsächlich kommunales Abwasser. Laut Bescheid hat sie eine Ausbaugröße von 320.000 EW. Mit einem Einwohnerwert von rund 154.000 EW (in 2022) behandelt sie jedoch weniger Fracht als ursprünglich vorgesehen. 126.000 Einwohner sind reell angeschlossen (Einwohnerzahl EZ). Die restlichen 28.000 Einwohnergleichwerte (EWG) sind industriellen Ursprungs (EZ+EWG=EW). Damit ergibt sich ein Industrieanteil des zu behandelnden Abwassers von rund 18%. Haupteinleiter sind die Papierindustrie, das Metallgewerbe und eine Mälzerei. Die maschinelle Faulschlammentwässerung erfolgt mit zwei Dekantern (X4E-4/454, BJ 2023). Die Entwässerung soll mit bestmöglichem Austrags TR bei optimalem Polymerbrauch durchgeführt werden. Der Abscheidegrad liegt bei > 98% (gem. DWA M-383); das Zentrat wird zurück zur Kläranlage geleitet. Für die Eindickung und Entwässerung wird ein Emulsionspolymer eingesetzt. Der anfallende Überschussschlamm wird mit drei Zentrifugen (GEA UCD 346 BJ 2012) unter Einsatz von Emulsionspolymeren maschinell eingedickt.

title: Prestations d’ingénieur pour l’assainissement, le réaménagement et l’extension de la Stiegstrasse et du Stiegweg
description:
Le présent appel d’offres porte sur les prestations d’ingénierie relatives aux phases SIA 32 (Projet d’ouvrage) à 53 (Mise en service, clôture) pour la planification et la réalisation des infrastructures routières, des réseaux souterrains et des ouvrages de gestion des eaux dans le secteur du Sonnenberg.

Le projet comprend l’assainissement de la Stiegstrasse, la construction du nouveau Stiegweg ainsi que le renouvellement et l’extension des infrastructures de réseaux. Les principaux défis consistent en la réalisation de franchissements sans tranchée de la Sihltalstrasse et de la ligne SZU au moyen de microtunnelage et de forages par fonçage, la construction des puits nécessaires à ces travaux, ainsi que la coordination des différentes mesures relatives aux réseaux souterrains et aux canalisations. En outre, l’ensemble des procédures d’autorisation et d’approbation requises auprès des autorités compétentes et des propriétaires des réseaux devra être assuré.

Étendue des travaux :

  • Assainissement de la Stiegstrasse : env. 920 m
  • Construction du nouveau Stiegweg : env. 65 m
  • Construction d’une nouvelle conduite d’eaux pluviales : env. 800 m, y compris microtunnelage
  • Remplacement d’une conduite d’eau potable : env. 120 m, y compris forage par fonçage
  • Remplacement d’une conduite d’eaux mixtes : env. 120 m
  • Aménagements paysagers et espaces verts dans le périmètre du projet

title: 26068 Alakylän koulun irtokalusteet
description: 26068 Alakylän koulun irtokalusteet Seinäjoen kaupunki pyytää tarjoustanne Alakylän koulun irtokalusteista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Alakylän koulua peruskorjataan ja uudisrakennetaan vuosien 2026-2027 aikana, siten että valmistuminen pitäisi olla syyskuun 2027 lopussa. Koulun pihan saneeraus ajoittuu kesiin 2027- 2028. HANKINTAMENETTELY Kyseessä on ns. varhaisen vaiheen kilpailutus, jossa valittu toimittaja sitoutuu suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan koulun irtokalustuksen kokonaisuudessaan yhdessä käyttäjien kanssa. Hankinnan kohde ja sille asetetut vaatimukset on tarkemmin kuvattu liitteenä olevissa tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Tarjoajien huomiota kiinnitetään siihen, että tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen suunnitelmat ovat ainoastaan alustavia ja nämä tulevat täydentymään kalustettavan Alakylän koulun rakennustöiden ja kalustamista koskevien lopullisten suunnitelmien edetessä. Tarjoaja antaa tarjouksen pilottitilojen kalustuksesta sekä muiden tilojen suunnitteluprosessista. Valittavalle toimittajalle kuuluu tämän jälkeen irtokalustuksen kokonaissuunnittelu yhdessä tilaajan kanssa sekä kalusteiden toimittaminen laadittuja sisustussuunnitelmia noudattaen. Tilaaja on listannut ensivaiheen kalustettavat pilottitilat sekä niihin toivottavia kalusteita ja ominaisuuksia. Toimittajilta pyydetään suunnitelma pilottitilojen kokonaiskalustuksesta. Hankinnan toinen vaihe toteutetaan osallistavan varhaisen vaiheen -mallilla, jossa huomioidaan loppukäyttäjien osallistaminen suunnitteluvaiheeseen yhteistyössä valitun kalustetoimittajan kanssa. Hankinnan 2. vaiheen toteutus perustuu tarjoajan tekemään projektisuunnitelmaan. Lopullinen toisen vaiheen aikataulutus suunnitellaan yhdessä tilaajan ja valitun toimittajan kanssa. Hankinnan kokonaisarvo on enintään 200 000 euroa, ilman alv. Talousarvio 2027 käsitellään kaupunginvaltuuston marraskuun kokouksessa.,

title: Trøastrømmen Fv. 6466
description: 1 Arbeidenes art og omfang Langs Fv. 6466 (Dyrøyveien) på Trøa i Frøya kommune ligger Trøastrømmen bru (FV6466 K S1D1 m5929). Vegen over Trøastrømmen bru har en ÅDT på 675 med andel lange kjøretøy på 12%. Fartsgrense på stedet er 50 km/t. Dagens Trøastrømmen bru er bygget i 1960 og har følgende spesifikasjoner: • Spennvidde på ca.11,9m og total brulengde ca. 12,7m. Kjørebredden er på 3,75 m og total brubredde er 5,05 m. • Trøastrømmen bru er klassifisert for Bk 10/60, veggruppe A etter forsterkning av bjelker i 1999. • Landkar akse 1 er støpt betong, antatt uarmert. Fundamentering på fjæresteiner. Landkar akse 2 av murt naturstein, og fundamentert direkte på berg. • Vingemurer av murt naturstein. • Hovedbæring består av to stk HEA60 stålbjelker, fritt opplagt. • Brudekke av armert betong. • Brurekkverk av stål, byttet i 2020. • Brua har lengdefall 1:20 og tverrfall 1:25 Kappestøp av betong vil bli utført på begge landkar og tilhørende vingemurer i 2026 eller tidlig 2027. Se vedlegg av prosjekteringstegninger av kappestøp og fravik for bruk av landkar Brudekket har omfattende armeringskorrosjon og store skader, i tillegg til en del korrosjon på hovedbjelker. Trøndelag fylkeskommune anser derfor fullstendig bytte av bruoverbygning med rekkverk som nødvendig. Kontraktsarbeidet består av prosjektering og bygging av ny valgfri bruoverbygning til Trøastrømmen bru. Den nye konstruksjonen skal være tilpasset eksisterende landkar og ha føringsbredden og avstand mellom rekkverk på minst 5,0 m. Maks vekt av ny bruoverbygning kan ikke overstige 60 tonn. Grunnet mye trafikk og ingen omkjøringsmuligheter for nødetater og beboere, kan ikke Trøastrømmen være trafikkstengt i lengere periode enn en helg med ønsket stengetid så kort som mulig. Under stengeperioden skal det være etablert parkeringsplass til nødetater og beboere. Entreprenør står ansvarlig for å etablere/anskaffe en midlertidig parkering og nødvendig gangbru slik at det skal være mulig å krysse Trøastrømmen til fots. Prosjektet skal gjennomføres modellbasert, og modellinformasjon skal leveres i Trimble Connect-rom etablert av byggherre. I tillegg skal prosjektet suppleres med all nødvendig tegning der dette kreves for myndighetsbehandling og godkjenning (herunder kontroll og godkjenning fra Vegdirektoratet), samt med tegninger som ivaretar krav til drift og vedlikehold. Nærmere beskrivelse av omfang, funksjoner og krav er gitt konkurransegrunnlagets kapittel D. Krav til BIM Byggherren har lagt ved egen BIM-manual og matrise for egenskapsdatasett som entreprenøren med sine konsulenter forplikter å bruke i prosjektet, prosjekterende konsulent utarbeider fagspesifikke BIM-vedlegg etter eget behov. Byggherren oppretter prosjektrom i Trimble Connect hvor alt av modeller og tegninger skal leveres løpende gjennom hele prosjektet. Dette er primær plattform for all koordinering av modell og tegning.

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Forschungsprojekt - DZSF - Mobilitätskettenanalyse - Wie Verkehrsdaten den ländlichen Schienenverkehr stärken können
description: Durch das Projekt sollen Mobilitätsketten im ländlichen Raum mittels einer Methodentriangulation analysiert und dabei insbesondere die Rolle des Schienenpersonenverkehrs (SPV) untersucht werden. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Vergleich und der Verknüpfung von objektiven Verkehrsdaten mit subjektiven Angaben zur Nutzung und Wahrnehmung der verschiedenen Verkehrsmittel. Neben dem Sammeln und Erheben von Daten in ausgewählten Fokusregionen, dienen ergänzende, experimentelle Studien dazu, kausale Aussagen über die Wirksamkeit von Maßnahmen zur Förderung des Nutzens nachhaltiger Mobilitätsketten im ländlichen Raum anstellen zu können.

title: Netherlands – Construction work – RWK Programma
description: Brabant Water staat aan de vooravond van een omvangrijk meerjarig programma gericht op het toekomstbestendig maken van het reinwaterkelderareaal (verder: RWK Programma). Aanleiding voor dit programma zijn onder meer eerdere incidenten met verontreinigingen, de toenemende leeftijd en diversiteit van het RWK‑areaal en aangescherpte eisen ten aanzien van kwaliteit, veiligheid en beveiliging van de drinkwatervoorziening. Uit inventarisaties is gebleken dat een deel van de reinwaterkelders niet langer voldoet, waardoor ingrijpen noodzakelijk is om de betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit van de watervoorziening op de lange termijn te borgen. Om de leveringszekerheid nu en in de toekomst te waarborgen voert de afdeling productie van Brabant Water één openbare aanbesteding verdeeld in twee percelen gericht op het contracteren van langjarige samenwerkingspartners voor het ontwerp en de realisatie van RWK projecten uit. Het programma heeft tot doel het reinwaterkelderareaal toekomstbestendig te maken en daarmee de betrouwbaarheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit van de drinkwatervoorziening voor de komende decennia te borgen. Vanuit de marktconsultatie is het RWK Programma opgezet met een duidelijk programmatische aanpak, continuïteit in opdrachtverlening en ruimte voor samenwerking en kennisontwikkeling. Voor meer inhoudelijke informatie verwijzen wij naar de aanvraag van Perceel 1 "Nieuwbouw" en Perceel 2 "Voorbouw en Maatwerk"

title: Uimaopetuksen hankinta 2027
description: Uimaopetuksen hankinta 2027 Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia uimaopetuksesta. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Tilaaja valitsee kaksi (2) toimittajaa sekä yhden (1) varatoimittajan. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo neljälle vuodelle ilman arvonlisäveroa (alv 0 %) on 2 500 000 euroa. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana. Ennen tarjousten jättöaikaa järjestetään vapaaehtoinen tutustumiskäynti seuraaviin uimahalleihin: Leppävaaran uimahalli Keski-Espoon uimahalli Espoonlahden uimahalli Matinkylän uimahalli Tutustumiskäynti järjestetään viikolla 49. Ilmoittautuminen käynteihin 27.11. mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: virpi.mikama@espoo.fi. Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti ja markkinavuoropuhelun kautta. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti.,

title: 26-417-SA Renfort d’équipe Installations de sécurité
description:
Pour la maintenance et le développement de son réseau, CFF Infrastructure a besoin d’un soutien externe de personnel pour les éléments des installations de sécurité des installations intérieures et extérieures. Cela comprend les appareils d’enclenchement, les systèmes de contrôle de l’état libre de la voie, les passages à niveau, les signaux, les équipements et chauffages d’aiguille ainsi que les installations de manœuvre. 


Le présent appel d’offres prévoit la passation du marché relatif aux prestations de location de services dans le domaine des installations de sécurité pour une durée de deux ans, avec option de prolongation à trois reprises d’un an. 


CFF SA adjuge le marché à plusieurs soumissionnaires dans le cadre des différentes fonctions, au sens de la loi fédérale sur les marchés publics (LMP). 


Chaque fonction se verra attribuer un nombre minimum de marchés jusqu’à couvrir les besoins mis en adjudication (ETP +25% conformément à la liste de prix). title: Strategic Environmental Research and Development Program Core Broad Agency Announcement
description: BOTH SMALL BUSINESS AND LARGE BUSINESS ARE ENCOURAGED TO RESPOND. The Department of War�s (DoWs) Strategic Environmental Research and Development Program (SERDP) is interested in receiving pre-proposals for research focusing in the areas of Environmental Restoration, Resource Conservation and Resilience, and Weapons Systems and Platforms. This notice constitutes a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) as contemplated in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (RFO) 6.101(b)(3)(ii)(A). Readers should note that this is an announcement to declare SERDP�s intent to competitively fund research and development for environmental research that addresses the Statements of Need (SON) set forth in the Announcement. SERDP supports research relevant to the management and mission of the DoW and supports efforts that lead to the development and application of innovative technologies or methods that improve the performance of DoW by improving outcomes, managing risks, and/or reducing costs or time required to resolve installation problems. The Program Announcement and complete submittal instructions are found on the DoW SERDP website at https://serdp-estcp.mil/workwithus. To be eligible for consideration, readers wishing to respond to this announcement must submit a pre-proposal in accordance with all instructions on the SERDP website no later than 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on 7 January 2027. No electronic mail, faxed, or hard copy proposals will be accepted. No other announcement of this opportunity will be made. It is the sole responsibility of the proposer to make certain the proposal is properly received by SERDP. Awards will take the form of contracts. Submission of pre-proposals is not restricted in any way to any particular entity. The Government will not pay for any costs associated with the preparation of proposals or travel to present oral presentations in support of the proposals. There is no commitment by SERDP to make any contract awards, nor to be responsible for any costs incurred by the offeror before contract award is made. It is anticipated that multiple awards totaling approximately $10 million will be made available for projects dependent upon the quality of proposals received and availability of funds. Awardees under this BAA will be selected through a multi-stage review process. The pre-proposal review step allows interested organizations to submit research pre-proposals for Government consideration without incurring the expense of a full proposal. Based upon the pre-proposal evaluation by SERDP, each of the pre-proposal submitters will be notified as to whether SERDP requests or does not request the submission of a full proposal. As noted in the instructions located on the SERDP website, evaluation criteria for pre-proposals are, in decreasing order of importance, Technical Merit, Personnel, and Cost. Due to the anticipated volume of pre-proposals that will be received, SERDP will not provide debriefs on those that are not requested to submit a full proposal. Instructions for preparing a full proposal will be provided at the time of notification. A request for submission of a full proposal does not indicate a decision has been made to make an award for that work. Evaluation criteria for full proposals will include Transition Plan in addition to the criteria above. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 541715 with the small business size standard of 1000 employees. Prior to award, selected contract proposals that exceed $900,000 submitted by all Other than Small (large or non-profits, including universities) Business concerns must be accompanied by a Small Business Subcontracting Plan in accordance with RFO 52.219-9 and elements as described in the checklist in RFO DFARS PGI 219.206-3 at http://business.defense.gov/Acquisition/Subcontracting/Subcontracting-Guide. Selectees who are located outside the United States and outlying areas who will perform their project outside of the United States and outlying areas are exempt from submitting a Small Business Subcontracting Plan. The US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Mission Support Battalion (UMSB) Small Business Office website at https://www.usace.army.mil/HECSA/HECSA-Small-Business/ provides information on how to prepare a subcontracting plan, along with links to find small businesses to participate. See the attached instructions for additional information regarding Small Business Subcontracting Plans. Additionally, please see the attached template for submitting an Individual Small Business Subcontracting Plan. Points of Contact: Procedural/Technical Questions - SERDP Office 571-372-6565 Contract Questions � UMSB Shannon N. Benson 703-428-7407; shannon.n.benson@usace.army.mil Small Business Participation or Subcontracting Plan - UMSB Small Business Representative Monique Holmes 202-934-1816, HECSASmallBusinessProgram@usace.army.mil

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. Interested sources may contact Jonathan Moore, Contracting Officer at jonathan.moore@dla.mil, Timothy Stark, Contracting Officer at timothy.1.stark@dla.mil, Nikki Rooksby, Contract Specialist at nikki.rooksby@dla.mil, or Lexy Sweitzer, Contract Specialist, at lexy.sweitzer@dla.mil to be added to our offeror mailing list. Secure Documents As this requirement will be an unrestricted, competitive action, several of the solicitation documents will be posted as �secured� on the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities website. In order to view those documents, vendors will need to obtain special access. The process of obtaining access is somewhat lengthy, therefore all interested vendors are encouraged to begin that process as soon as possible. Instructions for obtaining access are provided below. Should any party have issues with obtaining access to SAM.gov or the secure documents, they must notify the contracting office no later than September 29, 2026. Notifications to the contracting office of the inability to access secure documents after that suspense will not be a consideration in extensions to the Request for Proposal date. To ensure all parties are able to retrieve secure documents for this solicitation, a test document has been placed under secure package: SP060026R0813. Instructions for access to the Contract Opportunities Controlled Site To access the controlled, but unclassified, documents in the SAM.gov system, Offerors are required to be registered in SAM.gov. A CAGE Code and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) are created through the SAM.gov registration process at https://sam.gov/. Offerors must create a login.gov account in SAM.gov. Instructions are below. For additional help, contact the Federal Service Desk at www.fsd.gov or toll free at 1.866.606.8220. To link to an existing login.gov account From https://sam.gov/ go to sign in on the toolbar. Enter an email address and password for the existing login.gov account. Offerors will then receive an email to associate the existing login.gov account with SAM.gov. Offerors will now use this login.gov account to sign into SAM.gov. New users will be asked to complete their SAM.gov profile. To create a new login.gov account From https://sam.gov/ go to sign in on the toolbar. Select create an account. Enter an email. Offerors will receive a link with a security code via email. Go to the link and enter that security code and press continue. Create a password. Press continue. Select the method to receive one-time security codes in the future. Note: The recommended method is Text message/SMS. As part of the registration process, Offerors will be prompted to select a second authentication method. Once the login.gov user account is created, sign in at SAM.gov and navigate to the solicitation using the �Search Contract Opportunities� link. Click on a controlled attachment to initiate the request for access. A message will appear stating �You are not on Authorized Parties List. To get added to the Authorized Parties List Contractors must submit form DD2345 or you can request for Request access.� Enter a �Reason for Access� and click Submit. Offerors will be notified of the response to the request. Please note that Offerors will now need to request access for each attachment individually. Offerors that already have Joint Certification Program (JCP) certification are encouraged to verify its information in the JCP system at https://www.public.dacs.dla.mil/jcp/ext/. Incorrect information may result in rejection of request and delays in access to controlled documents. Instructions for obtaining JCP certification or for correcting a current JCP certification are as follows: Applicants for JCP certification are required to have an updated and correct SAM.gov registration, UEI, CAGE Code, and login.gov account. Applicants for JCP certification are required to complete a NIST assessment and upload it to SPRS. NIST assessments are valid for 3 years, must be documented in SPRS, and must be current more than 90+ days. Applicants must review and completion the Introduction to Proper Handling of DoD Export-Controlled Technical Data through https://www.dla.mil/Logistics-Operations/Services/JCP/. All applications must be completed through the JCP Portal. The portal may be accessed through https://www.dla.mil/Logistics-Operations/Services/JCP/ or directly at https://www.public.dacs.dla.mil/jcp/ext/. Click the Registration link below the Login button to navigate to the Registration page. Register either with a username and password. The Register � User Name and Password page is for use by users not in possession of a Government Common Access Card (CAC). All JCP Portal users logging in with a username and password must enable Two Factor Authentication (TFA) on the JCP Portal account. Log in to the JCP Portal account with the username and password. A prompt requires the TFA set-up on the account. Set-up Google Authenticator on a smartphone. Google Authenticator will be used upon each log in attempt. title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. title: Germany – Underwear – Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche
description: Dem LZN obliegt die Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen für die unmittelbare niedersächsische Landesverwaltung (vgl. § 2 der Betriebsanweisung des LZN). Mit Zustimmung seiner Aufsichtsbehörde kann das LZN weitere Aufgaben für öffentlich-rechtliche Bedarfsträger innerhalb und außerhalb der niedersächsischen Landesverwaltung sowie für privatrechtliche Gesellschaften in vollständiger Eigentümerschaft der öffentlichen Hand übernehmen (vgl. § 3 Betriebsanweisung). In dieser Zuständigkeit umfasst der Auftrag den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Unternehmen (§ 21 VgV) über die Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche für die Kooperationspartner der norddeutschen Küstenländer der Polizei und Justiz, der Landesforsten und Ordnungsämtern innerhalb von Deutschland und sonstige Behörden (gemäß Anlage) mit einer Preisbindung von 24 Monaten sowie optional zwei einseitige Vertragsverlängerungen zu jeweils höchstens 12 Monaten mit einem Unternehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind der Leistungsbeschreibung -Technischer Teil (Teil B) inkl. Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind den technischen Lieferbedingungen und dem Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Transmission apparatus for radiotelephony, radiotelegraphy, radio broadcasting and television – Aufbau und Erneuerung Sport Campus
description: Auf Beschluss der ARD soll der ARD-SportHub zentral beim WDR in Köln etabliert werden. Ziel des Projekts ist die schrittweise Errichtung einer zukunftsweisenden, crossmedialen Produktionsumgebung für Sportformate. Der Fokus liegt auf der Optimierung redaktioneller, produktions-technischer und infrastruktureller Arbeitsbedingungen sowie der Einführung moderner, Medien-over-IP-basierter Produktionstechnologien. Bereits seit Januar 2025 produziert der WDR alle Sportgroßereignisse für die gesamte ARD, jeweils unter Federführung der zuständigen Landesrundfunkanstalt (LRA). Die neuen Produktionsräume werden in Köln im Gebäude Arkaden, 3.OG, aufgebaut. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst neben einer FS-Regie u.a. diverse Multifunktions-räume, einen Dispatcherraum, zwei Hörfunkregien inkl. Studios, ein Podcaststudio und mehrere OffTube Kabinen. Weiterhin ist Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung die Errichtung von bis zu 50 redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen in diversen Büros und auf offenen Flächen. Der 2015 in Betrieb genommene Sport Campus im Gebäude Arkaden, 2.OG, bietet aktuell den Platz für alle an den Herstellungsprozessen der WDR-Sportproduktionen beteiligten Fachbereiche (Redaktion, Produktion und Technik). Der vorhandene Raum besteht aus einer großen Open-Space-Fläche mit daran angeschlossenen redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen, Konferenzräumen und technisch ausgestatteten Produktionseinheiten auf Basis klassischer Broadcasttechnik. Von dort aus werden alle relevanten Ausspielwege, insbesondere für die "Sportschau", "Sportschau.de" und deren Social-Media-Kanälen bedient. Das Herzstück wird die neue Sport Campus Regie auf Basis einer Live-IP-Infrastruktur bilden, die neben ihrer bestehenden Anbindung zur Presenterfläche im Open-Space-Bereich des Sport Campus zusätzlich auf die Studioflächen in der Rechtschule zugreifen soll, um kleinere Produktionen aus der Sportschau-Deko oder aus der Greenbox abzuwickeln. Die weiteren Produktionseinheiten des Sport Campus werden technisch an die neuen Multifunktionsräume im 3.OG angeglichen.
